blocks.prompt: 10 A sum of Rs. 5000 becomes 6324.48 when invested at 8% per annum, compounded annually. Find the time \(t\).
blocks.explanation:
A discrete compound interest question in reverse: the final amount is given and the time is unknown.
\(t\) is in the exponent of \((1.08)^{t}\).
Plan: divide by 5000, take \(\ln\) of both sides, use \(\ln(a^{t}) = t\ln a\).
steps:
Given: \(P = 5000\), \(A = 6324.48\), \(r = 0.08\), \(n = 1\).
To find: the time \(t\) (years).
Method: with \(n = 1\) the formula is \(A = P(1 + r)^{t}\); the unknown is in the exponent, so take logarithms.

Make the power stand alone
\[(1.08)^{t} = \dfrac{6324.48}{5000}\]
\[= 1.264896\]
Why: divide both sides by 5000.

Take \(\ln\) of both sides
\[t\ln(1.08) = \ln(1.264896)\]
Why: \(\ln(a^{t}) = t\ln a\) brings \(t\) down.

Solve for \(t\)
\[t = \dfrac{\ln(1.264896)}{\ln(1.08)}\]
\[= \dfrac{0.234990}{0.076961}\]
\[\approx 3.05\]
Why: divide by \(\ln 1.08\). Common logs give the same result.

Check
\[5000(1.08)^{3.05} \approx 6322.8\]
\[\approx 6324.48\]
The small difference comes from rounding \(t\) to 3.05. Note that exactly 3 years would give \(5000(1.08)^{3} = 6298.56\).

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The answer key prints \(t \approx 3\) years. That is only the value rounded to the nearest whole year: with the printed data, \(t = \frac{\ln 1.264896}{\ln 1.08} \approx 3.05\) years. After exactly 3 years the amount would be \(5000(1.08)^{3} =\) Rs. 6298.56, not Rs. 6324.48.
